name: Block Component Library
description: Adds an opt-in checkbox to custom block types and lists the flagged blocks as reusable components in a Content admin view.
project_description:
"The media library for blocks as components". 

 Provides a block component library to define and use custom blocks as reusable components. 

 Back to top 

 Why? 
 This functionality is very helpful for site / content administrators to separate this kind of component from technical blocks. This is why we also decided to place this list in the "Content" area of administration.

 Back to top 

 How? 
 On each block type a checkbox "Add to block component library" is added and a view is created under /admin/content/block-content-component-library which lists these blocks.

 Back to top 

 Dependencies 
 
 VBO ( https://www.drupal.org/project/views_bulk_operations )
